## What's Changed
* fix: guard history replay sends, show untracked files, refine public-mode enforcement by @RealKai42 in https://github.com/MoonshotAI/kimi-cli/pull/872
* feat: add session rename and AI auto-title generation by @RealKai42 in https://github.com/MoonshotAI/kimi-cli/pull/874
* fix(web): align bullet points by @Sepush in https://github.com/MoonshotAI/kimi-cli/pull/876
* feat(open-in): add Antigravity app support by @Sepush in https://github.com/MoonshotAI/kimi-cli/pull/822
* feat: add session pagination/search and work-dir cache by @RealKai42 in https://github.com/MoonshotAI/kimi-cli/pull/890
* fix(kosong): handle string annotations in SimpleToolset return type check by @0xWelt in https://github.com/MoonshotAI/kimi-cli/pull/889
* fix(auth): switch from sessionStorage to localStorage for authentication token management by @RealKai42 in https://github.com/MoonshotAI/kimi-cli/pull/891
* feat(makefile): add check-web target for web project linting and type checking by @RealKai42 in https://github.com/MoonshotAI/kimi-cli/pull/892
* feat(chat): implement slash command functionality and UI components by @RealKai42 in https://github.com/MoonshotAI/kimi-cli/pull/893
* fix(auth): resolve multi-session OAuth token refresh race conditions by @stdrc in https://github.com/MoonshotAI/kimi-cli/pull/898
* feat(sessions): add directory auto-creation with confirmation dialog by @RealKai42 in https://github.com/MoonshotAI/kimi-cli/pull/897
* feat(rust): add rust version of kimi agent kernel - `kagent` by @stdrc in https://github.com/MoonshotAI/kimi-cli/pull/717
* chore: bump version to 1.7.0 by @stdrc in https://github.com/MoonshotAI/kimi-cli/pull/902

## New Contributors
* @Sepush made their first contribution in https://github.com/MoonshotAI/kimi-cli/pull/876

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/MoonshotAI/kimi-cli/compare/1.6...1.7.0

## What's Changed
* fix(cli): avoid swallowing startup errors by @xxchan in https://github.com/MoonshotAI/kimi-cli/pull/906
* chore: bump version to 1.8.0 by @stdrc in https://github.com/MoonshotAI/kimi-cli/pull/908


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/MoonshotAI/kimi-cli/compare/1.7.0...1.8.0
